summary: @servicetitan/data-query preinstall fetches Bun runtime and executes an obfuscated bundle on npm install
details: package.json declares `"preinstall": "node setup.mjs"`. setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime zip from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases (bun-v1.3.13) into a temp directory, extracts the platform-appropriate `bun`/`bun.exe` binary, marks it executable, and invokes it via `execFileSync` against the sibling file `math_init.js`. `math_init.js` is a ~727KB Bun-compiled bundle (`// @bun @bun-cjs`) with classic obfuscation: rotating string-array indirection (`WV8StW` shift loop), a ~1000-entry mixed-literal string table (`n7gIxM`), and single-letter mangled identifiers. The bundle is never referenced from the declared library entry (`dist/index.js`) — the only invocation path is the preinstall chain that fetches an alternate runtime specifically to execute this opaque payload, whose behavior is unrelated to the advertised data-query purpose of the library. The Bun runtime is fetched from its official source, but that runtime is used to run shipped attacker-controlled obfuscated code on the installer at `npm install` time.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
